content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RITES to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for RITES Recruitment 2026 is 11 October 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 11 vacancies for the Individual Consultant posts announced by RITES in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the RITES Individual Consultant positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Individual Consultant posts in RITES Recruitment 2026 is 63 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for RITES Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for RITES Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for RITES Individual Consultant posts involves Document Scrutiny followed by an Interview of shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What are the minimum qualifications required for RITES Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifications vary by post, but generally include Graduate in Civil Engineering, Postgraduate degrees in relevant fields like Structural Engineering, Geology, or Diploma in Survey Engineering.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range for RITES Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The salary for RITES Individual Consultant posts ranges from Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 1,70,000 per month, depending on the specific post and responsibilities.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from any state apply for this RITES recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from any state can apply for this recruitment. The job location is specified as Gurgaon, Haryana.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for RITES Recruitment 2026 is entirely online through the official RITES website.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official RITES Recruitment 2026 notification?
faq.answer: The official RITES Recruitment 2026 notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article, or directly from the RITES official website.
